title: Exploratory testing: a session with a charter and notes

videos.script: Every script checks what somebody thought to write down. {{script}} The defects it misses are the ones nobody thought to ask about. {{missed}} Exploratory testing goes after those. You learn, design and run tests at the same time, and each answer decides your next step. {{explore}} That is not clicking around. A session has a mission written first, called a charter. {{charter}} It has a fixed time box, notes kept as you go, and a short conversation when it ends. {{debrief}} And when you run out of ideas, a heuristic hands you a question you had not thought of. {{heuristic}} In this lesson Ana runs a one-hour session on the orders of boxoffice 1.1. {{session}} She finds two defects that no requirement and no script pointed at. One of them needs the clock to move, and that turns out to be harder than it sounds. {{clock}} You can run the same session yourself, and keep the notes she kept. {{notes}}
